name: NORDIC NANOVECTOR ASA NORDIC NA
summary: NORDIC NANOVECTOR ASA is a biotechnology company focusing on the development and commercialization of targeted therapeutics for treatment of cancer, with a focus on hematologic malignancies. The company's lead product candidate is Betalutin, a radioimmunotherapeutic drug designed to deliver targeted radiation to cancer cells. Nordic Nanovector is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.
